1.1: THE ELDER to the elect Lady, and her children, whom I love in the trueth: and not I onely, but also all that have knowen the trueth,
1.2: For the trueths sake which dwelleth in us, and shalbe with us for ever:
1.3: Grace be with you, mercie and peace from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ the Sonne of the Father, with trueth and love.
1.4: I reioyced greatly, that I found of thy children walking in trueth, as we have received a commandement of the Father.
1.5: And now beseech I thee, Lady, (not as writing a new commandement unto thee, but that same which we had from the beginning) that we love one another.
1.6: And this is that love, that we should walk after his commandements. This commandement is, that as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
1.7: For many deceivers are entred into this world, which confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. He that is such one, is a deceiver and an Antichrist.
1.8: Look to your selves, that we lose not the things which we have done, but that we may receive full reward.
1.9: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that continueth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Sonne.
1.10: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not to house, neither bid him, God speed:
1.11: For he that biddeth him, God speed, is partaker of his evil deedes. Although I had many things to write unto you, yet I would not write with paper and ynke: but I trust to come unto you, and speak mouth to mouth, that our joy may be full.
1.12: The sonnes of thine elect sister greet thee, Amen.

63:1:1: This is no proper name, but to be taken as the word soundeth, that is to say to the worthy and noble Lady.
The bond of Christian conjunction or linking together, is the true and constant profession of the truth.
63:1:3: With true knowledge, which hath always love joined with it, and following it.
63:1:4: According as the truth directeth them.

This true profession consisteth both in love one toward another which the Lord hath commanded, and also especially in wholesome and sound doctrine, which also is delivered unto us: for the commandment of God is a sound and sure foundation both of the rule of manners and of doctrine, and these cannot be separated the one from the other.
63:1:7: Antichrists fighting against the person and office of Christ, were already crept into the Church in the time of the Apostles.
63:1:8: He that maketh shipwreck of doctrine, loseth all.
63:1:10: We ought to have nothing to do with them that defend perverse doctrine.
